scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently "cd backend && npm run test:coverage" "cd frontend && npm run test:coverage"
scripts.check:prisma-sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const b=fs.readFileSync('backend/prisma/schema.prisma','utf8'); const f=fs.readFileSync('frontend/prisma/schema.prisma','utf8'); if (b!==f) { console.error('Prisma schemas are out of sync!'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('Prisma schemas are synchronized.'); }"
scripts.sync:prisma: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('backend/prisma/schema.prisma', 'frontend/prisma/schema.prisma'); console.log('Copied backend schema to frontend.');"
scripts.qa: npm run check:prisma-sync && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
